lines.en: Bones shift shape under my skin.
My joints creak, but I still walk.
The full moon lasts — walk slowly.

lines.zh: 这林子走了三夜，还没出去。
lines.en: Three nights in this wood, still not out.
The puddle shows me. Stay back.
When the full moon rises, I change.

lines.zh: 离满月还有几夜，我数着。
lines.en: I count the nights until the full moon.
The smell of this place is off.
On the full moon I change.

lines.zh: 谁把窗户关上了，我不喜欢。
lines.en: Who shut the window? I dislike it.
Three nights I've circled this wood.
Mud sticks to my feet; one step, one pause.

lines.zh: 我等着那道光打在我身上。
lines.en: I wait for that light to strike me.
This face forgot how to smile.
I leave only after three moons.
Tonight is the full moon. I know.
That bird stares at me, unaware.
shadow fell off again.
The moon is one sliver short.
This spot gives me a clear view of you.

lines.zh: 太静了，活物都躲起来了。
lines.en: Too quiet. The living are hiding.
Before dawn, I need a shadow.
You saw me. Don't blink.

lines.zh: 满月的光，正照在我背上。
lines.en: Full-moon light falls on my back.
The iron in your hand won't cut my skin.
That armor will take some tearing.
You're smaller than last moon's prey.

lines.zh: 三个月亮周期后，我就走。
lines.en: After three moon cycles, I'll leave.

lines.zh: 你的心，跳得整片林都听见。
lines.en: Your heart beats loud enough for the whole wood.
The Hunted? Doesn't look like one.
My armour has not grown in yet.

lines.zh: 你踩进我投下的黑里了。
lines.en: You've stepped into the dark I cast.
Your face is carved on my teeth.

lines.zh: 满月快到了，我感觉得到。
lines.en: The full moon is near. I can feel it.
Something alive? How long has it been.

lines.zh: 皮下的东西，扯一下就合。
lines.en: What's under my skin knits in a pull.
Again; before the full moon I feel no pain.
Bones break; they grow back.
The bones are growing, it aches.
That one tore the skin.

lines.zh: 群系再大，也只出一只我。
lines.en: Any biome, and only one of me.
Both my mouths gape with the pain.
Don't touch. I still hurt before the full moon.
Wait till I change. Then run.
The full moon's charge hasn't faded.
Rotten is fine. I'm not picky.
Your leftovers will do; I am not picky.

lines.zh: 你兜里那点吃的，漏味了。
lines.en: The food in your pocket is leaking smell.
Sweet? I only know warm.

lines.zh: 只要那块，别的一概不要。
lines.en: Just that piece. Nothing else.
The full moon isn't here yet. I wait.

lines.zh: 月亮圆起来，我就要疼了。
lines.en: When the moon rounds out, I start to ache.
Why shake? I don't bite hands.

lines.zh: 满月那道光，已经击中我了。
lines.en: The full moon's bolt has already struck me.
That warmth in your hand — give it.
Don't crowd. This shadow is mine.
Growl, stop shoving me.
One look at the full moon and I change.
You knocked my jaw crooked.
You walked into my arms.

lines.zh: 满月的光，正打在我身上。
lines.en: The full moon's light is on me now.

lines.zh: 我很少出现，一出现就变天。
lines.en: I rarely appear, and when I do, things change.
You stepped on my fingers.
Who bumped me? The full moon is overhead.
Don't press so close. I'm hungry.

lines.zh: 月亮一满，我就不是现在这样。
lines.en: At the full moon I become something else.
This body still wants company.

lines.zh: 月光落到背上，我开始长高。
lines.en: Moonlight on my back, and I start to grow.

lines.zh: 你也吃人，那我们是一路的。
lines.en: You eat people too — we're alike.
The moon has not set; do not leave yet.
You smell like my cave.
Villagers bring torches. Ignore them.
I'll be gentle. I won't bite through.
A litter, all with two mouths.
The nest is that way — follow me.
Found it near shadow.
I picked it up. Best not to look.
This helmet fits perfectly.

lines.zh: 捡东西的样子，别盯着看。
lines.en: Don't stare while I pick it up.
Who left this bag here?

lines.zh: 这骨头，比我自己的还白。
lines.en: This bone is whiter than mine.
This stone fits a skull nicely.
The grip is still warm. Freshly dropped.
These boots fit my feet.
This iron shard could open a throat.

lines.zh: 我等着被那道能量击中。
lines.en: I wait for that bolt of energy to hit me.
When the moonlight shifts, I shift.
When the energy struck, I was waiting.
That beating in your chest is mine.
Don't wait for me to finish counting.
The full moon has not reached its peak.

lines.zh: 我的喉咙在响，别装听不见。
lines.en: My throat is growling. Don't pretend.
Go hide. I'll wait for the full moon.
The moon is pushing me tonight.
Turn around. I'm there.
The blood on you is warm.
Turn your back. Easiest to strike.

lines.zh: 喊也没用，这林子里没人。
lines.en: Screaming won't help; no one's here.
A breath at your back — that's me.
This way — more mouths wait.
Under moonlight, you can't hide.
Up a tree? I climbed those as a child.

lines.zh: 你的脚步乱了，我听着呢。
lines.en: Your steps are stumbling. I hear them.
The full moon and I change.
Run further and you hit the trees.
The more you run, the stronger you smell.

lines.zh: 月亮升起来了，你听见了吗？
lines.en: The moon is up. Do you hear it?
Your friend doesn't run any slower than you.
A wooden door rots at one claw.

lines.zh: 你换了方向，我闻得出来。
lines.en: You changed direction; I can smell it.
My legs are long. You won't escape.

lines.zh: 你往哪跑，都是我的林子。
lines.en: Wherever you run, it's still my wood.
Take the detour. I know this ground.
Panting like that — how many steps left?

lines.zh: 三个月亮不睡，我也撑得住。
lines.en: Three moons without sleep, I endure.

lines.zh: 权重只有一，可我还是来了。
lines.en: Spawn weight of one, and I still came.
That pack at your feet — you forgot it.
I was in these woods before you.
Your footprints are in the mud.
The footsteps stopped. Where are you?
Under the full moon, running won't help.
Just one bite. Hold still.
Catch my head — it bites.
That energy is almost on me.
I'm tall enough to reach you.
Backing to a corner. Perfect.
These claws are for skin.

lines.zh: 雷能量在我身体里攒着。
lines.en: Bolt energy gathers inside me.
Knees buckle, and it's over.

lines.zh: 月圆那晚，雷劈在我身上。
lines.en: The night the moon was full, lightning struck me.
Scream. I like that sound.
The flesh in the gaps is softest.
That plank won't stop me.

lines.zh: 月亮一圆，我就不一样了。
lines.en: When the moon fills out, I won't be the same.
My hands won't stop. Bear it.
My hand is heavier than it looks.
The hunted becomes the hunter.
The second bite, with my other mouth.
My two mouths never keep guests.
Don't strain. I'm not full.
Don't blink. Watch me.
The smell of soil is still under my nails.
The full moon is not here yet, so I walk.
darkness. I've arrived.

lines.zh: 我站在这里，等下一次满月。
lines.en: I stand here waiting for the next full moon.
No one to keep me company — then I'll eat you.
First, where does life breathe?
A growl from my throat — listen.
I've crawled out of the shadows.
Just crawled out; my legs are weak.
The clearing is too bright; I slip behind the trees.
This light is too bright; I squint.
This time I stay until the moon is full.
Wake, sniff — where are the living?

lines.zh: 这一带只有我一个，权重一。
lines.en: Only one of me here. Spawn weight one.
One spark of fire and my hide curls.
The fall set even my bones screaming.
Both mouths fill with water.
Not full moon yet. Wait.
An arrow? I'll keep it in.
Those words crawl in my bones.
Both my mouths growl with hunger.

lines.zh: 满月那道能量，打中了我。
lines.en: The full moon's energy struck me.

lines.zh: 我只有一个，满月也只有一晚。
lines.en: There's one of me, and one full moon.
